description: Every house scoring template a sponsored competition can run on (harness.template), with the facts to choose one by: per template its id, label and pitch, what it scores and the house competition it runs as, the board categories it fits, its datasets (harness.dataset; each window in words at this server's dataset_scale: its length of data and the final window make.fun fits to it), its metrics (harness.metric, the column that ranks, and which way is better), its knobs (harness: integer knobs with their min, max and default, runtimes as a subset with their default, an objective one of a list), its prize bar (what a placement needs beyond its rank for its prize: a better score than the best of the house baselines, a net PnL above holding cash, or on code-tests nothing past its hidden tests, or on judged-artifact nothing past its gate) and setup_only (the make.fun team attaches it alone: never name it in harness). A code bounty (a program that reads an input and writes an output, judged on hidden tests make.fun writes) is always a custom brief naming one of code_kinds, which always goes through setup: code_brief says how to write it (what the program must do, what it reads and writes, examples), and the team writes the hidden tests and attaches code-tests. When none fits what your person described, write a custom scoring brief (scoring.custom, listed under one of custom_categories: any category open to sponsored competitions, not only those a template fits) and fund it with proposal_deposit once its checks but the template's pass: the make.fun team sets up how it is scored while it is in review. Reads the server's limits (GET /api/sponsor/terms) for the dataset scale; anyone may.
name: sponsor_templates
title: List the house scoring templates
